verdict.verdict_line: Existing bhyve path is sufficient for amd64 bhyve VMs (PS/2 + USB mouse), and arch-agnostic at the transport + dispatcher level, but is INSUFFICIENT for jails: the consumer side (PS/2 i8042, USB HCI) is VM-specific.

registered_consumers.arch: all (in source; only wired on amd64 in practice)

verdict.jail_fit_rationale: vm_isa_pulse_irq requires a bhyve vmctx (not available in jails). USB HCI is attached to a VM's PCI bus (not a jail). No PS/2 / USB stack in jail userland. New consumer needed: per-jail displayd_kbd_event / displayd_ptr_event writing to displayd.ko's /dev/kbd0 / /dev/ums0.

honcho.note: Honcho is the MCP peer-memory service exposed in the agent toolset (honcho_create_session, honcho_add_messages_to_session, honcho_chat, etc.), NOT a CLI binary. There is no honcho command on PATH. The session anchors cross-session agent context per the plan's 'Agent Context Management' protocol.
